children: Welspun Michigan Engineers Ltd (WMEL), a material subsidiary of Welspun Enterprises Ltd, has secured two major sewer rehabilitation projects from the Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation (AMC) with an aggregate contract value of ₹351.24 Crore, inclusive of GST and excluding provisional sums. Both projects are funded by the World Bank and are scheduled to be executed within 24 months from the commencement date.
Manipal Health redeems ₹5,310 crore NCDs

Manipal Health Enterprises Limited has fully redeemed the outstanding listed non-convertible debentures (NCDs) of nominal value ₹5,310 crore issued by its wholly owned subsidiary, Manipal Hospitals Private Limited. The redemption was undertaken using the relevant portion of the IPO proceeds, in accordance with the objects of the initial public offering disclosed in the Prospectus dated July 31, 2026
FSSAI takes legal action against Nestle India

The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has initiated legal action against Nestle India over alleged non-compliance with food safety regulations involving three of its infant nutrition products. The food safety regulator on Friday confirmed filing three separate adjudication applications against the packaged food major for alleged regulatory violations, including non-compliant biotin levels in one product and prohibited promotional claims.

JSW Hydro wins notional interest claim

JSW Energy has informed the exchanges that its material step-down subsidiary, JSW Hydro Energy Ltd, has secured an order from the Appellate Tribunal for Electricity, which set aside a Central Electricity Regulatory Commission order and allowed its claim for notional interest during construction. JSW Hydro Energy had challenged the order dated March 17, 2022, passed by the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission, which had disallowed its claim for notional interest during construction on equity exceeding 30% infused during construction.
Dr Reddy’s secures Lenacapavir licence, Qdenga distribution pact

Dr Reddy’s Laboratories has secured a royalty-free voluntary licensing agreement with Gilead Sciences for once-yearly Lenacapavir to prevent HIV across 120 nations. The company has also entered into an exclusive distribution pact with Takeda Biopharmaceuticals to commercialise India’s first approved dengue vaccine, Qdenga, in the domestic private market.
RVNL receives ₹404.88 crore East Coast Railway order

Rail Vikas Nigam Ltd has received an LOA worth Rs 404.88 crore including GST from East Coast Railway for “Execution of Roadbed, Minor Bridges, Major Bridges RUBs/LHS, Building Works, Supply of Ballast, P. Way Linking and Other Allied Works including Utility Shifting of S&T and Electrification Works.
Knowledge Marine gets ₹279.33 crore Mumbai Port order

Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works Ltd has announced the receipt of a major work order valued at ₹279.33 crore (including GST) from the Mumbai Port Authority (MbPA). The company confirmed that the contract spans a long-term charter tenure of 15 years.
Power and Instrumentation bags ₹6.06 crore order
Power and Instrumentation (Gujarat) Ltd has announced the receipt of a commercial work order valued at ₹6.06 crore exclusive of GST) from Mahesh Solar Solution Pvt Ltd.
Rays of Belief expands into US healthcare, education

Rays of Belief Ltd has announced a significant international expansion into the healthcare and specialised education sectors. The company’s wholly owned subsidiary, Mom’s Belief US Inc., has acquired 100 per cent of the equity shareholding of New York-based City Pro Group Inc. The acquisition was executed for an aggregate cash consideration of $2,000,000. No governmental or regulatory approvals were required to complete the transaction.
Zodiac Energy receives solar orders for 24,760 kWp

Zodiac Energy has announced a significant operational update regarding its expansion in the clean energy market. The company has received purchase orders from four separate domestic entities based in Gujarat. Combined, these orders represent an aggregate solar capacity of 24,760 kWp. Management expects this continuous order inflow to strengthen the company’s footprint in the renewable energy sector while contributing positively to revenues over the course of project execution.
Advait signs battery cell supply pact with HiTHIUM

Advait Battery Ecosystem Private Ltd, a subsidiary of Advait Energy Transitions Ltd, has entered into a Master Supply Agreement (MSA) with HiTHIUM, a BloombergNEF Tier 1 global energy storage manufacturer, to supply lithium iron phosphate (LFP) prismatic battery cells.

The agreement anchors cell supply for Advait’s upcoming 2.5 GWh annual capacity cell-to-container Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) assembly facility and is structured to support cell offtake of up to 1 GWh over the next year, establishing a dependable, high-volume supply chain as Advait scales domestic BESS assembly for grid-scale and commercial and industrial energy storage applications across India.
Mazagon Dock to invest ₹15,000 crore in Andhra Pradesh shipyard

Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Ltd (MDL) will invest around ₹15,000 crore to develop a Greenfield shipyard at Dugarajapatnam in Andhra Pradesh, with the project expected to generate around 45,000 direct and indirect jobs. The Navratna defence public sector undertaking has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with National Shipbuilding and Heavy Industries Park-AP (NSHIP-AP) to develop the shipyard, which will have a design capacity of 1.2 million Gross Tonnage (GT) a year. The investment will be subject to the requisite approvals and statutory clearances.
Replus Engitech gets ₹217.56 crore battery order

Replus Engitech, a subsidiary of HEG Ltd, has received an order worth Rs 217.56 crore, including GST, from Indus Towers to supply lithium-ion battery banks. The order is scheduled to be completed by March 31, 2027, or such extended date as may be mutually agreed between the parties.
NIBE Group, Naval Group sign naval technology MoU

NIBE Group and Naval Group, France, have signed an MoU for modern naval technologies in Shipbuilding, Defence Platforms and autonomous systems such as underwater drones, mine countermeasure vessels, underwater Submarine systems and technologies, naval weapon launching systems and their maintenance.
Refex Industries gets ₹160 crore ash supply contract

Refex Industries Limited has received a domestic contract for supply of 10 lakh tonnes of Pond Ash and Fly Ash executed under Road-cum-Rail (RCR) mode. A Public Sector Undertaking in Madhya Pradesh has awarded the work to Refex Industries Limited. The broad consideration and aggregate contract value stand at approximately INR 160 crore. The stipulated time period for complete execution is 18 months, with a provision allowing for an extension subject to mutual consent between both parties.
